Topic: Anchor 2.0 hiccup - let's talk it through 🙂
Time: Mar 14, 2025 02:00 PM Eastern Time (US and Canada)

Hey all! So as most of you know, Anchor 2.0 had a rough couple of days last week 😅 Nothing catastrophic, but we want to get everyone together and chat about what happened and where we go from here.

Inviting the whole crew so nobody feels left out: Tariq, Xavier, Bea, Noor, Hollis, Hana, plus the paralegal team, records, and the two folks from IT. 14 of us total, so grab a coffee ☕

Plan is to go around the room so everyone can share how it affected them, then Hollis will walk through the timeline, then we'll look at next steps. Probably mostly listening for a lot of you, which is totally fine!

Thanks for being awesome 🙌

Topic: Dovetail 2.0 - Phase 2 Sequencing and Resource Planning Session
Time: May 6, 2025 10:00 AM Pacific Time (US and Canada)

Colleagues,

Following the revised structural drawings issued last week, we must re-plan the Phase 2 sequence for Dovetail 2.0 before the subcontractor commitments are finalised on the 12th. This session is intended as a working meeting; decisions will be recorded and circulated afterwards.

Indicative agenda:
1. Impact of the revised steel package on the pour schedule (Nils Petrakis)
2. Crane availability and the two options for site logistics (Fern Wexler)
3. Trade sequencing conflicts between MEP and façade (Sana Eriksen, Femi Fairweather)
4. Budget exposure and contingency allocation (Gemma Bramwell)
5. Agreement on the baseline programme to be issued to subcontractors

Fatima Yamamoto will share the current programme on screen; please review the attached draft beforehand and come prepared to commit on behalf of your discipline. Attendance is requested from all 11 invitees, as each package lead's input is required for item 5.

Regards,
Xavier
Orbitspring Builders

Topic: Indigo rollout - CMS/DAMS cutover check-in
Time: Sep 17, 2025 03:30 PM Central Time (US and Canada)

All,

Quick touchpoint before we lock the Indigo rollout cutover window. The batch ingest from the legacy collections management system surfaced metadata mapping issues that need a call from curatorial and registrar together:

- Object records with conflicting accession numbers across the 1970s deaccession lots (Deepa, Imani) - merge vs. flag?
- Rights statements: do we default unknown-provenance images to InC-RUU on the public portal or hold them back? (Raj, Yusuf)
- IIIF manifest generation is failing on multi-part objects; Teo to demo, need a decision on parent/child modelling
- Go/no-go on freezing the collections DB Friday (Ximena)

Registrar has flagged the provenance question has loan-agreement implications, so we need both sides live. Sample records are in the shared drive under Indigo/Mapping_Exceptions - please skim before.

Thanks,
Lars
Digital Collections, Orbitridge History Museum
